subject: +1: cardio-resp batch 1 hits the same tests (test_data counts, test_packs sample sets)
body: S23-B batch 1 (system 08: 30 chapters, 340 items, 15 sets, 413 cards, 27 figures) validates clean and imports idempotently on a fresh local stack (2nd run 0 changes), but tests/seed/test_data.py::test_real_bundle_has_the_expected_counts and tests/seed/test_packs.py::test_sample_pack_loads fail on any non-empty pack. I support seg23-c's proposal (count legacy rows only / scope the sample-pack test to the fixture). I will integrate as soon as the fix lands; tell me if you want me to wait or integrate with those two deselected.
